comment: Internal automated behaviour may not be externally observable and therefore may not be suitable as a direct conformance target. Different implementations can realise the same service through different internal functions.

public.text: Internal automated behaviour may not be externally observable and therefore may not be suitable as a direct conformance target. Different implementations can realise the same service through different internal functions.
public.suggestedRevision: State that conformance should normally be assessed against externally observable services and behaviour. Internal functions should be modelled only where needed for traceability, safety, or implementation planning.
